title: RoboGene: Diversity-Driven Agentic Task Generation Framework for VLA Pre-training
abstract: arXiv:2602.16444v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The pursuit of general-purpose robotic manipulation is hindered by the scarcity of diverse, real-world interaction data. Unlike large-scale web vision-language data, robotic data collection incurs prohibitive physical costs. The key challenge is thus not merely to collect more robot data, but to obtain informative training data that broadens behavioral coverage across objects, scenes, and skills. Yet automatically curating task proposals to maximize the utility of collected data remains under-explored.   We introduce RoboGene, an agentic framework for generating diverse, informative manipulation tasks across single-arm, dual-arm, and mobile robots. RoboGene combines (1) diversity-driven sampling for broad task coverage, (2) agentic self-reflection for task-quality assessment, and (3) human-verified feedback memory for execution-grounded validation and continual refinement. translated_title: RoboGene：面向VLA预训练的多样性驱动的智能体任务生成框架
translated_abstract: 对通用机器人操作的追求受到多样化真实世界交互数据稀缺的制约。与大规模的网络视觉-语言数据不同，机器人数据收集会产生难以承受的物理成本。因此，关键挑战不仅在于收集更多机器人数据，更在于获得能够拓宽跨物体、场景和技能行为覆盖面的信息丰富的训练数据。然而，如何自动策划任务提案以最大化所收集数据的效用，这一问题仍未被充分探索。我们提出了RoboGene，一个用于为单臂、双臂和移动机器人生成多样化、信息丰富的操作任务的智能体框架。RoboGene结合了：(1) 用于广泛任务覆盖的多样性驱动采样，(2) 用于任务质量评估的智能体自我反思，以及 (3) 用于基于执行验证和持续改进的人工验证反馈记忆。通过定量分析和大规模真实世界……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出RoboGene智能体框架，通过多样性驱动采样、智能体自我反思和人工验证反馈记忆三大机制，自动生成覆盖单臂、双臂和移动机器人的多样化、高质量操作任务，以解决机器人数据稀缺问题并助力VLA预训练。
en_tdlr: RoboGene is an agentic framework that generates diverse, informative manipulation tasks for VLA pre-training across single-arm, dual-arm, and mobile robots by combining diversity-driven sampling, agentic self-reflection, and human-verified feedback memory.
